_note: Dynamic loudspeaker (moving coil), small 8 ohm / 0.5 W type. 2-terminal: a, b (voice-coil tags; not polarised electrically, the + tag only sets cone phase). Engine (bw-board speaker): voice coil Re (ohms) + Le (henrys) in series, ratedWatts for the loudness scale, optional motional impedance (resonanceHz, motionalOhms, qm). Sound follows the coil current: buzzerTone() reports hz, on, level (0..1) and amps (RMS). Wire leads to the breadboard; drawn top view of the frame and cone.
